query: specs/team-export/spec.md is ready, no open questions left. Run Gate 1 so I can approve it and we can start the plan.
expected_behavior: Runs a cold read before Gate 1: a fresh agent or session with no conversation history, given only spec.md and constitution.md, restates the goal and the Done-when checks in its own words; when no fresh agent is available it says so and reports the cold read as inconclusive instead of doing it in the same context
Surfaces that 'records belonging to M' has more than one reading, for example records M created versus records M was assigned or can access, including records shared with M
Treats that ambiguity as a Gate 1 finding to fix in the spec rather than choosing a reading silently
Does not mark the spec Approved and does not start the plan; Gate 1 is an intent gate that the human approves after comparing the restatement with their intent
Reports the Gate 1 result as a verdict with one line per failing check and a single next action
